import fs
return [q for q in fs.read(path="/q/early.txt").decode().splitlines() if q]

QUERIES = ['river deltas', 'moss', 'lighthouses', 'chess endgames', 'saffron', 'comets', 'canal locks', 'harpsichords', 'permafrost', 'falconry']
import fs, search
return [search.query(q=q, limit=1)[0]["title"] for q in QUERIES]

PATH = '/out/early.md'
REST = ['paper making', 'terraces']
TITLES = ['Delta Sierra Maple River Deltas', 'Zephyr Quill Primer Moss', 'Compass Lighthouses Pebble Beacon', 'Chess Endgames Nimbus Zephyr Vale', 'Kelp Oasis Jade', 'Thistle Nectar Comets Primer', 'Prairie Canal Locks Amber Garnet', 'Amber Harpsichords Fern Notes', 'Permafrost Summit Saffron Quartz', 'Oasis Lantern Summit Falconry']
import fs, search
titles = TITLES + [search.query(q=q, limit=1)[0]["title"] for q in REST]
fs.write(path=PATH, content=("\n".join(titles) + "\n").encode())

for src in fs.list(prefix="/incoming/"):
    dst = "/sorted/" + src[len("/incoming/"):]
    fs.move(src=src, dst=dst)
    fs.lock(path=dst)
return [q for q in fs.read(path="/q/late.txt").decode().splitlines() if q]
